tests: on pull_request a stored witness is evaluated because the diff changes, moves or renames inside a test file it runs

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The pull-request selection reads the phase diff git prints (src/witness/run.ts computePhaseDiff, --no-renames) to decide whether a test file a stored witness runs changed. The capture is real git output for a moved test file, a D of the old path and an A of the new one, and the named test compares the fixture's own name-status to it. The member drops the test-file arm.
